body:
Follow-up to `garment-optics` (its structural-colour next step), track 6. Transfer-matrix model of quarter-wave oxide stacks on a flat nylon-like substrate: 6-pair stacks reach 99% reflectance with 2-3 g/m2, peak blue-shifts 620 to 540 nm by 60 degrees (dE76 48), and 10% layer-thickness error gives median dE76 about 10. Stylised, simulation only; flat substrate, constant indices, equal-energy illuminant. Citations are from memory and flagged as unchecked in the README. 8 tests; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
